relations: As the radiating water jets shorten and retract, the streaming shapes break into discrete round beads.
Water accumulates as a beaded film across the gear teeth, leaving the copper surface increasingly wet.
Scattered droplets on the transparent sheet, including a column below the gear, drift downward within the frame.
The copper assembly drifts downward and rightward, bringing more of the clamp's pale upper body into view at the top.
caption: The video captures, through a transparent sheet, a blurred bearded man in safety glasses watching from a grassy background as a copper gear-shaped object hangs from a metal clamp at the top. A polished metal tube enters from the right edge, its open end pointed left toward the gear. The gear is ringed by a starburst of short radiating water jets, with elongated streaming droplets trailing left. These jets shorten and retract, and the streaming shapes break into discrete round beads. Water accumulates as a beaded film across the gear teeth, leaving the copper surface increasingly wet. Scattered droplets on the sheet, including a column below the gear, drift downward within the frame. The copper assembly drifts downward and rightward within the frame, bringing more of the clamp's pale upper body into view at the top.
